title: Faculty Onboarding
noPermission: You do not have permission to onboard faculty.
startNewConfirm: Discard this draft and start onboarding a different faculty member? The current draft record is left in place (visible on the Teachers list as incomplete) and can be finished or removed from there later.
cancelConfirmDraft: Cancel onboarding? Everything entered so far is kept as a draft — it shows up as "Incomplete" on the Teachers list, and clicking Add Teacher again will offer to resume it.

validation.nameRequired: Enter the faculty member's full name.
validation.emailRequired: Enter an email address, or turn off "Create a login account now".

draftBanner.message: You have an unfinished faculty onboarding draft. Resume it, or discard it and start a new one.

account.tempPasswordHint: A temporary password will be generated and shown once — the faculty member must change it on first login.
account.skippedHint: No login account will be created. This faculty member can still be given one later from Users → Create Account.
